open: Synthetic-memory layer only: one Json tree family and two scales. Not full-input-domain equivalence; not device equivalence.
The attachment loader (atlas region dims/UVs) and all timeline creators are declared synthetic boundaries on both arms; they are aligned by construction, not recovered equivalence.
The 21-word pointer values cannot be compared across arms; they are normalized to non-null presence and per-element records.
The original arm's bump heap is zero-filled and deterministic; the original's behavior on real malloc garbage is not measured.
The error tree covers the Parent-bone tail only; the other nine dispose-bearing tails are not in this input set.
